questions.question: How do you start an informal email?
questions.explanation: Informal emails to friends start with "Hi" followed by the name.

questions.question: How do you end an email to a friend?
questions.explanation: "Best wishes" or "See you soon" are good ways to end friendly emails.

questions.question: What is a "subject line" in an email?
options: A short description of what the email is about
questions.explanation: The subject line tells the reader what the email is about.

questions.question: Which phrase starts a letter nicely?
questions.explanation: "I hope you are well" is a polite and friendly way to start a letter.

questions.question: How do you end a letter?
questions.explanation: "Write back soon!" is a friendly way to end a letter to a pen pal.
